sents.t: Document 1: Memo
To: All Headquarters Employees From: Gregory Hall, Chief Operating Officer Date: August 4 Subject: Office Relocation
As many of you have already heard, Brightline Logistics will be relocating its headquarters from the Carver Building downtown to the Riverside Business Park next month.
I would like to explain the reasons for this decision and what it will mean for you.
Over the past five years, our company has grown rapidly.
We have doubled the number of employees at headquarters, and our current office no longer has enough space for everyone.
Several teams are already working in meeting rooms, and as a result, it has become increasingly difficult to find a place to hold meetings.
In addition, our lease at the Carver Building expires at the end of September, and the owner has informed us that the rent will increase by 30 percent if we renew it.
The new office at Riverside Business Park is nearly twice as large as our current one, and the rent is actually lower.
It also offers a number of benefits for employees, including a staff cafeteria, a fitness room, and free parking for up to 400 cars.
I understand that some of you may be concerned about your commute.
The business park is located about twelve kilometers from downtown, and it is not directly served by the subway.
To address this issue, the company will operate a free shuttle bus between Central Station and the new office every fifteen minutes during rush hours.
Employees who choose to drive will also be eligible for a monthly transportation allowance of $50 to help cover the cost of gas.
The move will take place in stages over three weekends in September, so that our daily operations are not interrupted.
A detailed schedule is attached.
Each department will be given packing boxes and labels one week before its moving date.
Please pack your personal belongings yourself and make sure that every box is clearly labeled with your name and department.
Computers, printers, and other equipment will be moved by our IT team and a professional moving company, Swift Move Services.
Do not try to disconnect or pack any equipment on your own.
On the weekends of the move, the Carver Building will be closed to all employees except members of the moving team.
If you need to pick up something urgently, you must arrange it with the facilities team at least one day in advance.
New security badges for Riverside Business Park will be distributed to all employees on September 10.
Your current badge will not work at the new building, so please do not forget to bring the new one on your first day.
I know that moving can be stressful, but I am confident that our new home will provide a much better working environment for all of us.
To celebrate the completion of the move, we will hold a welcome party in the new cafeteria on October 9.
I would also like to thank Ms. Bennett and her team, who have spent the past six months planning this move and negotiating the new lease.
Their hard work has made it possible for us to move without increasing our costs.
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact Facilities Manager Nora Bennett at extension 3120.
Document 2: Moving Schedule
Brightline Logistics Headquarters Relocation Schedule
Weekend 1, September 12 and 13: Human Resources, Legal, and Customer Service.
Weekend 2, September 19 and 20: Sales, Accounting, and the Executive Office.
Weekend 3, September 26 and 27: Marketing, Information Technology, and Research and Development.
Notes:
All boxes must be packed and placed next to your desk by 5:00 P.M. on the Friday before your moving weekend.
Employees will begin working at the new office on the Monday after their department moves.
Employees who are unable to work at either location during the transition may work from home with their manager's approval.
Items that are not labeled will be left behind and may be thrown away.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Will my desk and chair be moved to the new office?
A: No. The new office will be fully furnished with new desks and chairs, so old furniture will remain at the Carver Building.
Old furniture that is still in good condition will be donated to local schools and community centers.
Q: How many boxes will I receive?
A: Each employee will receive four boxes.
If you need more, please ask your department's moving coordinator.
We encourage everyone to use this opportunity to throw away old documents that are no longer needed.
Confidential documents must be placed in the locked shredding bins on each floor, not in regular trash cans.
Q: Will my phone number change?
A: No. All extension numbers will remain the same.
However, the company's main phone number will change on September 28.
Please update your e-mail signature and business cards by that date.
New business cards can be ordered through the online supply system free of charge.
Q: Can I visit the new office before my department moves?
A: Yes. Guided tours of the new office will be offered every Wednesday afternoon in August.
Space on each tour is limited to fifteen people, so please sign up through the company intranet in advance.
Q: What should I do with plants and other personal items?
A: Small plants may be packed in boxes, but large plants should be taken home before your moving weekend.
The moving company is not responsible for any damage to personal items.
Document 3: E-mail
To: Nora Bennett From: Priya Desai Date: August 6 Subject: Request regarding the moving schedule
Dear Ms. Bennett,
I am the manager of the Accounting Department, and I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to change our moving date.
According to the schedule, our department will move on the second weekend of September.
Unfortunately, the end of September is the busiest time of the year for us, because we must complete the quarterly financial report by October 2.
During the last two weeks of the quarter, my team works long hours and relies heavily on the files stored in our office.
If we have to pack everything and set it up again in the middle of this period, I am worried that we might miss the deadline.
Would it be possible for our department to move on the first weekend instead?
Alternatively, we would be happy to move after the report is submitted, if that is easier for you.
Either option would allow us to focus on the report without interruption.
I have already discussed this matter with Mr. Hall, and he suggested that I contact you directly.
My team would also appreciate receiving extra boxes, since we keep a large number of paper records.
I have one more question.
Our department has a large aquarium with six tropical fish, which has been in our office for almost ten years.
The fish are very popular with employees from other departments, who often stop by to watch them during their breaks.
The largest one, whom we call Mr. Numbers, is believed to be older than some of our interns.
I am not sure how to move them safely.
Should we arrange this ourselves, or will the moving company take care of it?
Thank you in advance for your help.
Best regards, Priya Desai
Document 4: E-mail
To: Priya Desai From: Nora Bennett Date: August 7 Subject: RE: Request regarding the moving schedule
Dear Ms. Desai,
Thank you for contacting me about this.
I completely understand your concern, and I am glad you let me know early.
I spoke with the manager of the Customer Service Department, and she has agreed to switch moving dates with your team.
This means that your department will now move on the first weekend, and Customer Service will move on the second weekend.
Please note that your boxes will therefore need to be ready one week earlier than originally planned.
I will make sure that your packing materials are delivered to your office by August 28.
Regarding your files, I would recommend that you scan any documents you will need during the move and save them on the shared drive.
That way, your team will be able to access them from home if necessary.
If your team members need help scanning a large number of documents, the IT department can lend you two high-speed scanners for the month of August.
Please let me know by August 15 if you would like to borrow them.
As for the aquarium, Swift Move Services does not handle live animals.
However, I have contacted a local company, AquaCare, which specializes in moving aquariums for offices and restaurants.
They will transport the fish in special containers and set up the tank at the new office on the same day.
The cost will be covered by the company, so you do not need to worry about that.
I have also reserved a spot for the aquarium in the new cafeteria, where more employees will be able to enjoy it.
I hope Mr. Numbers will like his new view.
Best regards, Nora Bennett
